text: SIX MORE PORTALS BUILD EVERY CONTROL FROM THE DESIGN SYSTEM. PM-AJAY, SAMBAL (NHAPOA), SCW, SMILE, Transgender and the hub's portal and report directories carried 70 raw <button> elements between them; they are Button, IconButton, Tabs, Chip, SegmentedControl, Accordion, RadioGroup, Search, Select, Breadcrumb, AccountMenu and SideSheet now. Three hand-built drawers — SCW's Add User panel, SMILE's filter sheet and SMILE's phone navigation — had no focus trap, so Tab walked out of an open dialog into the page behind; each is a SideSheet. Three sets of selectable cards announced as toggle buttons are card radios. The SCW account dropdown, which had no keyboard support, is the AccountMenu. PM-AJAY keeps its own published skin: its unlayered stylesheet still dresses the design-system controls, and its filter drop-downs are native filter Selects instead of a hand-built listbox. The PM-AJAY Unified Dashboard could not be opened at all — on a full page load it redirected to sign-in before the stored session was read, and sign-in forwarded to the home dashboard; it now waits for the session.
